name: Avodah
shortDescription: Church management software from Newcastle upon Tyne for people records, volunteer rotas, service planning, expenses and messages.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking a connected roster, people and expense-management tool
Teams that want mobile access for volunteer scheduling and member communication

pricing.summary: Avodah publishes a free Starter plan for up to 50 people and a $29-per-month Growth plan. The reviewed page does not publish GBP pricing, VAT treatment or a UK-specific tariff.

tiers.label: Starter
tiers.detail: Up to 50 people, basic roster scheduling and people database

tiers.label: Growth
tiers.detail: Unlimited people, advanced rostering, expenses, groups and communications

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier invites churches to start a free trial but does not publish its duration on the reviewed page.

gdprInformation: Avodah publishes a privacy policy with access, correction and deletion routes. It describes pastoral notes, contacts, messages and expenses, so a church should assess the current controller, processor, hosting and special-category-data arrangements before use.
support: Email support on the published Starter plan
Priority support on the published Growth plan

uk-location.value: The supplier privacy notice identifies Avodah Software at an address in Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom.

product-and-pricing.value: Supplier publishes a free Starter plan and a $29 monthly Growth plan, alongside roster, people, expense and communication features.

data-handling.value: Supplier privacy policy describes role controls, multi-tenant isolation, account deletion and the personal data processed by the platform.

editorial.assessment: Avodah brings volunteer scheduling, people records, expense workflows and service planning into one church-management product. Its official privacy notice gives a Newcastle address, but the supplier does not publish a company-registration number or a detailed UK commercial pack, making direct supplier due diligence particularly important before live adoption.
bestFor: Churches wanting connected volunteer, people and expense administration
Teams willing to evaluate a newer supplier through its free plan or trial
strengths: Free entry plan and published Growth price
Connected roster, people, expense and worship-planning workflow
Supplier publishes a detailed privacy notice and account-deletion information
limitations: Supplier does not publish a company-registration number
Pricing is shown in USD rather than GBP
Obtain current contractual, processor, hosting and support information before migrating sensitive records
